# UiStateList

One list the app's UI state holds: its name and the rows it starts with.

## Parameters

- `name`: A string. The name a [List](List.md) or [Menu](Menu.md) shows it by. Defaults to `""`.
- `items`: An array of strings. The text of each row it starts with. Defaults to `[]`.
